'''''Goober''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] used to decorate an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] piloted by [[Jay Igno/Legends|jay Igno]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The poster was [[Color/Legends|colored]] blue, lavender and yellow and was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].<ref name="Orders" />
